definitions.explanation: Pain or discomfort in the joints, often caused by injury, arthritis, or other conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Joint pain gets worse when it gets cold.

examples.japanese: {関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|のぼ}り→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦{下|お}り→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つらい→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: Going up and down stairs is hard because of joint pain.

examples.japanese: {関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had a test to find out the cause of my joint pain.

notes:
{関節痛|かんせつつう} is the medical term for joint pain.

FORMS:
⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧ (joint) + ⟦{痛|いたみ}→痛み：01795_itami⟧ (pain) = {関節痛|かんせつつう}

- {関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to have joint pain
- {関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ - joint pain is severe
- {関節痛|かんせつつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧ - to relieve joint pain
